established: Exact immutable repository revisions were pinned.
Canonical member paths, declared sizes, storage representations, and typed provider identifiers were reconstructed.
Bounded request/response accounting and zero payload download were preserved.
limitations: Large public repository listings are useful supply-chain cases because path, size, storage, digest, topology, payload, authority, and freshness claims must remain separate.
The report derives from pinned fixtures and is not a source-evidence identity.
not_established: Publisher authority, endorsement, model authenticity, and current state.
Payload-byte equality, security safety, tokenizer/config parity, and runtime identity.
Complete shard or tensor topology in the absence of an explicit parsed index.
provider_neutral_readiness: The same core preserves Kimi evidence limitations without upgrading prior claims.
DeepSeek remains a readiness profile until a reviewed pinned snapshot is supplied.
Provider profiles import the core; the provider-neutral core imports no xAI profile.
title: OMIV xAI Public Artifact Metadata Assurance Case Study
